 Brittany Snow’s Disco Dress Brought a Healthy Dose of Sparkle to ‘The Hunting Wives’ Season Two Premiere
 WWD Follow Julia Teti Add to Preferred Sources Fri, November 13, 2026 at 7:30 PM UTC Brittany Snow shimmered from head to toe at "The Hunting Wives" season two premiere held at The Egyptian Theatre in Los Angeles on Thursday night.
 Brittany Snow 
 The "Pitch Perfect" alum wore a disco-inspired dress with a sleeveless silhouette, rounded neckline and slit at the side. Disco ball-inspired silver sequins featured over the entire dress, creating a playful energy at the red carpet event.

 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The sleek design included some contrast, with a base beige fabric featured at the back. But the sparkling style was certainly the most eye-catching element. Snow also incorporated subtle glittering moments with her jewelry pieces, including rings and a set of small hoop earrings.
 Brittany Snow
 For a continued metallic touch to the overall look, Snow added a set of strappy silver heels. As for glam, the actress went old school with her hair and makeup. Glen "Coco" Oropeza coiffed Snow's hair with a side part and soft cascading waves.
 For makeup, the actress turned to artist Diane Buzzetta, who gave Snow a lined eye and glossy lip. Stylist Yael Quint, who also works with Olivia Munn and AnnaSophia Robb, among others, curated Snow's look.
 Brittany Snow, Malin Akerman and Jaime Ray Newman.
 Snow's Thursday night disco look was quite the departure from her more recent Y2K-inspired style moment . At the LACMA Gala on Nov. 7, Quint styled Snow in a Ralph Lauren pink gown from spring 2004 ready-to-wear collection.
 Advertisement Advertisement The dress certainly catered to the recent trend in which celebrities have embraced the Y2K craze by returning to designer runway looks from more than 20 years ago. The slip style, while bold in its use of color, gravitated toward that '90s minimalism and playful early aughts energy.
 Brittany Snow
 "The Hunting Wives" follows Sophie O'Neil, played by Snow, who finds her life upended by socialite Margo, played by Malin Akerman, who leads her down a path of obsession, seduction and murder. The second season of the Netflix series arrives Nov. 26 on the streaming platform.
